heading: Batch planning
intro: Batch numbers start at 1; the approved spec of 2026-08-31 calls the first batch 'batch 0'.

batches.summary: Tier-2 phase 4 (under HR-047): the binary reaches adopters — release binaries with checksums at every release-please tag, the mise/ubi channel, the README and seeded-workflow consumers flipped to the real channel, the pins wired into the release flow; external registry acts owner-attended and documented.

status.text: Done 2026-09-07: phase 4 wired whole under the two-step reality (spec section 7) - the cargo-dist pipeline pinned with the tag both matching and resolving, the crate version converged and lockstepped, every consumer flipped to the real channels with dated PENDING control runs, the pins wired via release-please, the seeded install step fallible, the release runbook with the owner-attended checklist. ALL FOUR ITEMS STAY OPEN by design: HR-049/063/064/070 close at the first release with assets (runbook step 6), behind HR-068 (the owner token decision) and HR-069 (the pr-run-mode revert). Step one proven; step two owner-attended.

batches.summary: A Dependabot PR that falls behind main gets its rebase without the owner; the batch-28 rollout record rides the branch.

status.text: Built and reviewed 2026-10-02 (spec section 9). Before the merge the owner stores the token as an Actions secret. HR-156 stays partial: it and HR-098 close on the first run that finds a behind pull request with auto-merge on and ends in a merge with no owner action (spec section 5). Resolved 2026-10-10 on the owner's ruling (design.md 5.96, D8): the owner stored the token in the Actions store; the controller rebased the branch onto main at v1.4.0 (the branch's code and workflow changes byte-identical to the reviewed head), CI passed, and the controller merged it fast-forward from the CLI as df1f228. The first run that found a behind pull request ended in a merge with no owner action (PR #53, HR-156): HR-156 and HR-098 are done. Acceptance waits for the owner.

batches.summary: The design-phase review gate (issue 38), the balancing mechanism against over-bureaucratizing, and the template-cluster riders, designed as one review mechanism.

status.text: Folded into batch 33 on 2026-10-15: every open GitHub issue ships in 2.0.0 (design.md 5.98), so HR-144 (issue 38) moved to batch 33. HR-129 and HR-153 had moved there on 2026-10-10 (design.md 5.96, D5). Batch 29 holds no item.

batches.summary: Process cost: a risk-tiered pipeline, review severity by impact and a bounded review loop, a self-optimizing knowledge base, and the cost analysis shipped to adopters.

status.text: Built 2026-10-09: risk tiers, severity by impact, the bounded review loop, parallel agents on disjoint files, the self-optimizing knowledge loop, and stats over several workspaces (design.md 5.90-5.93). HR-164 (Task 1's findings at its cap) and HR-166 (the fix wave's findings at its cap) are deferred; HR-158, HR-162, HR-163, HR-165 are filed. Merged 2026-10-09 as PR #54 and released as 1.3.0; acceptance pending the owner.

batches.summary: The adopter lead-time audit, minor-release half: template defects and several workspaces, controller rules out of task audits, a loading path for non-standing process rules, and findings that name their caller and their check.

status.text: Built 2026-10-10 as release 1.4.0 (design.md 5.94): template defects and several workspaces (HR-167), controller rules out of task audits through the `controller` tag (HR-168; the mechanism replaced the proposal's area-pattern test after the corpus run, spec 3.1 and 6), loading paths for non-standing process rules (HR-169), and findings that name their caller and their check (HR-170). Evals 15 of 15. Filed from the retrospective: HR-174, HR-175 (batch 33), HR-176. Merge, release, and acceptance pending the owner.

status.text: Built and reviewed 2026-10-20 under the approved spec and plan (design.md 5.169, 5.170): nine tasks, the eval run (15 of 15), a live run of every spec 16 case (20 of 20, case 17 with its accepted red), and the branch review on opus with its fix wave. The owner purged the full tier mid-batch (172, 173); Task 9 and the batch close ran the standard tier. HR-182 stays partial (5.152 ships in batch 34). The merge to main waits for the owner.
